verdict.rationale: MailerSend documents a broad public REST API covering async email sending, templates CRUD, webhooks, SMS, WhatsApp, email verification, scheduled messages, and account limits. It also offers official client libraries and an llms.txt index of its developer docs. missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes at standard paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
